metadata.track_name: Add Web-IDE demos and E2E tests for expression core features
metadata.goal: Add web-ide demos for sequence/file/cursor/multi-datasource features and Playwright E2E coverage.

phase.name: Demo Data Preparation

notes.note: Requirement update (2026-01-20): demo file loading should use workspace-relative paths; ensure demo data files can be referenced from the workspace root (not just server __dirname paths).

phase.description: Prepare CSV, JSON demo files and extend demo.db schema

task.name: Create CSV demo files
task.description: Create sales.csv and products.csv with sample data for file operation demos

acceptance_criteria.criterion: sales.csv created with columns: id, product, amount, date, region
products.csv created with columns: id, name, category, price
Both files contain 20-50 rows of realistic sample data
Files placed in packages/web-server/data/ directory

subtask.name: Write test for CSV file existence and structure

task.name: Create JSON demo files
task.description: Create config.json and users.json with nested structures for JSON operation demos

acceptance_criteria.criterion: config.json created with nested structure (e.g., settings.database, settings.api)
users.json created with array of user objects including nested fields
Files contain 10-30 records with realistic data
Files placed in packages/web-server/data/ directory

subtask.name: Write test for JSON file existence and structure

task.name: Extend demo.db schema
task.description: Add orders and customers tables to demo.db for join and cursor scenarios

acceptance_criteria.criterion: orders table created with columns: order_id, customer_id, product_id, quantity, order_date
customers table created with columns: customer_id, name, email, region_id
Tables populated with 100+ rows for cursor pagination testing
demo-init.sql updated with new table definitions

subtask.name: Write test for new table existence and schema

phase.name: Web-Server Enhancement
phase.description: Migrate web-server to use dataSourceConfigs API for multi-datasource support

notes.note: Requirement update (2026-01-20): demos should not rely on implicit datasource injection; add/adjust connect()/T()/path resolution support in spl-flow/web-server so that demo expressions can explicitly connect and load files relative to workspace root.

task.name: Migrate server.ts to dataSourceConfigs
task.description: Update server.ts to use dataSourceConfigs instead of connections Map

acceptance_criteria.criterion: server.ts imports ConnectionRegistry and createDataSourceHandle from spl-flow
SQLite datasource configured using dataSourceConfigs
CSV datasources (sales, products) configured using dataSourceConfigs
JSON datasources (config, users) configured using dataSourceConfigs
evaluateFlow receives dataSourceConfigs in context
Existing demos continue to work (backward compatibility)

subtask.name: Create dataSourceConfigs array with all sources
Update evaluateFlow calls to use dataSourceConfigs

task.name: Update server integration tests
task.description: Update server.integration.test.ts to cover multi-datasource scenarios

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Test added for CSV datasource query
Test added for JSON datasource query
Test added for multi-source query in single flow
All integration tests pass
DataSource handles are available in scope for CSV/JSON

subtask.name: Write test for CSV datasource query
Write test for JSON datasource query

phase.name: Web-IDE Demo Implementation
phase.description: Add demos to SplIde.vue showcasing new expression capabilities

notes.note: Additional requirement (2026-01-20): online IDE demos must explicitly connect and explicitly load file data (no implicit injection of db/files). See doc/brainstorm/port-expression-engine/act_5/summary1.md.

task.name: Add simple sequence operation demos

notes.note: Requirement update: Each demo should start by explicitly connecting to a database (e.g., A1=connect("demo"); A2=db.query(...)). Do not rely on implicit DB handle injection.

task.description: Add demos for select and sort operations

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Sequence Select demo added showing data filtering
Sequence Sort demo added showing data ordering
Demos use clear, understandable expressions
Demo descriptions explain what each expression does

subtask.name: Add Sequence Select demo to demos array
Add Sequence Sort demo to demos array

task.name: Add comprehensive data pipeline demo
task.description: Add demo combining select, sort, group, join, and derive

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Data Pipeline demo added with multi-step processing
Demo uses select to filter data
Demo uses sort to order results
Demo uses group to aggregate data
Demo uses join to combine datasets
Demo uses derive to add computed fields
Demo description explains the complete workflow

subtask.name: Write expressions for each pipeline step
Add Data Pipeline demo to demos array

task.name: Add file operation demos
task.description: Add demos for CSV and JSON file operations

notes.note: Requirement update (2026-01-20): CSV/JSON demos should load data via SPL-style T() or csv(file(...).read()) / json(file(...).read()) patterns, with non-absolute paths resolved from workspace root. Avoid implicit server-registered datasources for file reads.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: CSV Import demo added showing file read
JSON Processing demo added showing parse and transform
Multi-Format Integration demo added combining CSV and JSON
Demos use the new file datasources
Demo descriptions explain file operations

subtask.name: Add CSV Import demo to demos array
Add JSON Processing demo to demos array
Add Multi-Format Integration demo to demos array
Manually test all file demos in browser

task.name: Add cursor and multi-datasource demos
task.description: Add demos for cursor pagination and multi-datasource queries

notes.note: Requirement update: Multi-datasource demos must explicitly connect to required sources (DB + files) in the sheet before querying/using them.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Cursor Pagination demo added using fetch and skip
Multi-Source Query demo added querying SQLite, CSV, and JSON
Cross-Datasource Join demo added joining data from different sources
Demos demonstrate practical use cases
Demo descriptions explain cursor and multi-source concepts

subtask.name: Add Cursor Pagination demo to demos array
Add Multi-Source Query demo to demos array
Add Cross-Datasource Join demo to demos array
Manually test all cursor and multi-source demos in browser

phase.name: Playwright E2E Test Infrastructure

notes.note: After updating demo connection/file-loading behavior, update/extend E2E tests to assert explicit connect() and workspace-relative paths work.

task.description: Install Playwright dependencies and create configuration

acceptance_criteria.criterion: @playwright/test installed as dev dependency
playwright.config.ts created in project root
Config specifies test directory as packages/web-ide/__tests__/e2e/
Config includes browser settings (Chromium)
Config includes base URL and timeout settings
package.json updated with test:e2e script

task.name: Create E2E test helpers
task.description: Create helper utilities for starting/stopping services and waiting for UI

acceptance_criteria.criterion: helpers.ts created with service management functions
Helpers include proper cleanup and timeout handling
Helpers work for both frontend and backend processes
